atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(60, "Coil Lookback", 10, 200, 1)
rangeLen = input(60, "Range Lookback", 10, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
compThresh = input(0.75, "Compression Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
predThresh = input(0.55, "Predictable Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
relMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trueRange = max(tr1, max(tr2, tr3))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
atrPrev = atrVal[1]
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilLoad = 1 - atrVal / max(atrHigh, 0.000001)
rngNow = high - low
rngHigh = highest(rngNow, rangeLen)
rangeCoil = 1 - rngNow / max(rngHigh, 0.000001)
combinedLoad = (coilLoad + rangeCoil) / 2
atrChg = atrVal - atrVal[1]
vovNum = stdev(atrChg, vovLen)
vovDen = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = vovNum / max(vovDen, 0.000001)
vovPrev = vov[1]
risingVoV = vov > vovPrev
sumAbs = 0.0
for i = 0 to predLen - 1 {
    sumAbs = sumAbs + abs(close[i] - close[i + 1])
}
pastClose = close[predLen]
netMove = abs(close - pastClose)
predictability = netMove / max(sumAbs, 0.000001)
loaded = combinedLoad >= compThresh and risingVoV
loadedPrev = loaded[1]
expansion = rngNow > atrPrev * relMult
expRatio = rngNow / max(atrPrev, 0.000001)
buySig = loadedPrev and expansion and close > open and predictability >= predThresh
sellSig = loadedPrev and expansion and close < open and predictability >= predThresh
buyFire = buySig and not buySig[1]
sellFire = sellSig and not sellSig[1]

if buyFire { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellFire { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buyFire { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellFire { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate") }

bgcolor(loaded, "#22aaff")
plot(combinedLoad, "Combined Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(compThresh, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(predThresh, "#b48cff", "separate")
plot3d(combinedLoad, "Coil Load", "bars3d", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability", "ribbon", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(expRatio, "Expansion Ratio", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

sessStart = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
sessLen = input(20, "Session Length Bars", 5, 200, 1)
structLb = input(3, "Structure Lookback", 1, 20, 1)
bufTicks = input(2, "Breakout Buffer (ticks)", 0, 50, 1)
stopTicks = input(15, "Hard Stop Offset (ticks)", 1, 200, 1)
minConf = input(60, "Min Confidence To Signal", 0, 100, 1)

tickVal = close * 0.0001 + 0.000001
buf = bufTicks * tickVal
stopOff = stopTicks * tickVal

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
upperExtreme = sessHigh + buf
lowerExtreme = sessLow - buf
sessActive = bar_index >= sessStart

htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfClosePrev = htfClose[1]
htfClosePrev2 = htfClose[2]
htfHighPrev = htfHigh[1]
htfLowPrev = htfLow[1]
htfHighest = highest(htfHigh, structLb)
htfLowest = lowest(htfLow, structLb)
priorHigh = htfHighest[1]
priorLow = htfLowest[1]

bullStruct = htfClose > priorHigh and htfLow > htfLowPrev
bearStruct = htfClose < priorLow and htfHigh < htfHighPrev

bullBreak = htfClose > priorHigh + buf
bearBreak = htfClose < priorLow - buf
htfUp2 = htfClose > htfClosePrev and htfClosePrev > htfClosePrev2
htfDn2 = htfClose < htfClosePrev and htfClosePrev < htfClosePrev2

confBull = 50 + (bullBreak ? 25 : 0) + (htfUp2 ? 25 : 0)
confBear = 50 + (bearBreak ? 25 : 0) + (htfDn2 ? 25 : 0)
confCappedBull = confBull > 100 ? 100 : confBull
confCappedBear = confBear > 100 ? 100 : confBear
confVal = bullStruct ? confCappedBull : bearStruct ? confCappedBear : 50

var longPx = 0.0
var shortPx = 0.0
var posLong = 0.0
var posShort = 0.0

longStopPx = longPx - stopOff
shortStopPx = shortPx + stopOff
longStopHit = posLong == 1 and close <= longStopPx
shortStopHit = posShort == 1 and close >= shortStopPx

buySig = crossover(close, upperExtreme) and bullStruct and confVal >= minConf and sessActive
sellSig = crossunder(close, lowerExtreme) and bearStruct and confVal >= minConf and sessActive
buyExitSig = crossunder(close, sessHigh) or longStopHit
sellExitSig = crossover(close, sessLow) or shortStopHit

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confVal / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege_long")
    longPx := close
    posLong := 1
    posShort := 0
    shortPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confVal / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege_short")
    shortPx := close
    posShort := 1
    posLong := 0
    longPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buyExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege_long")
    posLong := 0.0
    longPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Flat", "cross", "#ffcc33")
}
if sellExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege_short")
    posShort := 0.0
    shortPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Flat", "cross", "#ffcc33")
}

activeStop = posLong == 1 ? longPx - stopOff : posShort == 1 ? shortPx + stopOff : close
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")
plot(activeStop, "Hard Stop", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")

breakoutLength = input(20, "Breakout Length", 10, 50, 1)
momentumLength = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
rangeLookback = input(10, "Range Lookback", 5, 30, 1)
rangeMult = input(1.0, "Range Mult", 0.5, 2.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

hh = highest(high, breakoutLength)[1]
ll = lowest(low, breakoutLength)[1]
mom = close - close[momentumLength]
curRange = high - low
maxPastRange = highest(curRange, rangeLookback)[1]
volExpand = curRange > maxPastRange * rangeMult

buySig = crossover(close, hh) and mom > 0 and volExpand
sellSig = crossunder(close, ll) and mom < 0 and volExpand

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, "3d")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, "3d")
}

plot(hh, "HH", "#22aaff", 1, "stepline")
plot(ll, "LL", "#ffaa22", 1, "stepline")
plot(mom, "MOM", "#cc44ff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(hh, "HH 3D", "line3d", "#22aaff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(ll, "LL 3D", "line3d", "#ffaa22", "3d", 1)
bgcolor(volExpand, "#22cc8822")

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6% Multiplier", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2% Multiplier", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50% Multiplier", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8% Multiplier", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

highestHigh = highest(high, lookback)
lowestLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = highestHigh - lowestLow

lvl236 = highestHigh - rng * f236
lvl382 = highestHigh - rng * f382
lvl50 = highestHigh - rng * f50
lvl618 = highestHigh - rng * f618

buySig = crossover(close, lvl618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, lvl382)

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibLast")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibLast")
}

plot(lvl236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(lvl236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lvl382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lvl50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(lvl618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "FastLen", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "MedLen", 20, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "SlowLen", 40, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(30, "SkewLen", 10, 60, 1)
compLookback = input(30, "CompLookback", 10, 60, 1)
expandMult = input(1.05, "ExpandMult", 1.0, 1.5, 0.01)
skewThresh = input(0.0, "SkewThresh", -0.5, 0.5, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = (close - close[1]) / max(close[1], 0.000001)
annF = 1587.4507860603
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * annF
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * annF
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * annF
hh = highest(high, skewLen)
ll = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = max(hh - ll, 0.0000000001)
pos = (close - ll) / rng
skew = pos * 2 - 1
spreadFM = fastVol - medVol
spreadFS = fastVol - slowVol
spreadMS = medVol - slowVol
slope = (fastVol - slowVol) / max(slowVol, 0.000000001)
lowFast = lowest(fastVol, compLookback)
comp = fastVol < medVol and fastVol < slowVol and fastVol <= lowFast * expandMult
expandUp = fastVol > fastVol[1] * expandMult and fastVol > lowFast * expandMult and comp[1]
skewXUp = skew > skewThresh and skew[1] <= skewThresh
skewXDn = skew < 0 - skewThresh and skew[1] >= 0 - skewThresh
spreadUp = spreadFS > spreadFS[1]
spreadDn = spreadFS < spreadFS[1]
warm = bar_index > slowLen

var lastSigBar = -1000000.0
coolOk = bar_index - lastSigBar > compLookback
buyRaw = expandUp and skewXUp and spreadUp and comp[1] and warm
sellRaw = expandUp and skewXDn and spreadDn and comp[1] and warm
buySig = buyRaw and coolOk
sellSig = sellRaw and coolOk and not buyRaw

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  model.longEntry()
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  model.shortEntry()
}
if buySig or sellSig {
  lastSigBar := bar_index
}
bgcolor(comp, "#1a2b3c")
plot(spreadFS, "Spread F-S", "#ffaa00", 2, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot(fastVol, "FastVol 2D", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot3d(medVol, "Term Surface", "manifold", "#2266ff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastVol, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)
plot3d(slowVol, "Slow Impulse", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(90, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
maxScale = input(100, "Max Scale", 10, 200, 1)
thicknessBase = input(1.0, "Thickness Base", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
thicknessFactor = input(0.05, "Thickness Factor", 0.0, 0.2, 0.005)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = change(close)

c1raw = ch1 + drift
c2raw = ch2 + drift
c3raw = ch3 + drift
c4raw = ch4 + drift
c5raw = ch5 + drift

c1low = c1raw < 0 ? 0 : c1raw
c1 = c1low > 100 ? 100 : c1low
c2low = c2raw < 0 ? 0 : c2raw
c2 = c2low > 100 ? 100 : c2low
c3low = c3raw < 0 ? 0 : c3raw
c3 = c3low > 100 ? 100 : c3low
c4low = c4raw < 0 ? 0 : c4raw
c4 = c4low > 100 ? 100 : c4low
c5low = c5raw < 0 ? 0 : c5raw
c5 = c5low > 100 ? 100 : c5low

h1 = c1 / maxScale * 100
h2 = c2 / maxScale * 100
h3 = c3 / maxScale * 100
h4 = c4 / maxScale * 100
h5 = c5 / maxScale * 100

arrayAverage = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5
curveThickness = thicknessBase + thicknessFactor * arrayAverage
splineCurve = arrayAverage + (h1 + h2 + h3 + h4 + h5) / 5 / 10

buySig = crossover(arrayAverage, 70) and c5 > c1
sellSig = crossunder(arrayAverage, 30) and c5 < c1
alertHigh = crossover(c1, 90) or crossover(c2, 90) or crossover(c3, 90) or crossover(c4, 90) or crossover(c5, 90)
alertLow = crossunder(c1, 10) or crossunder(c2, 10) or crossunder(c3, 10) or crossunder(c4, 10) or crossunder(c5, 10)
alertMid = crossover(arrayAverage, 50) or crossunder(arrayAverage, 50)
alertSig = alertHigh or alertLow or alertMid

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if alertSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Alert", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

plot(h1, "Cyl H1", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot(h2, "Cyl H2", "#ff8833", 1, "separate")
plot(h3, "Cyl H3", "#ffcc00", 1, "separate")
plot(h4, "Cyl H4", "#88dd44", 1, "separate")
plot(h5, "Cyl H5", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(arrayAverage, "Array Avg", "#44aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(curveThickness, "Curve Thick", "#ffffff", 1, "separate")

plot3d(h1, "Ch1 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 0)
plot3d(h2, "Ch2 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 1)
plot3d(h3, "Ch3 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#ffcc00", "separate", 2)
plot3d(h4, "Ch4 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#88dd44", "separate", 3)
plot3d(h5, "Ch5 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 4)
plot3d(splineCurve, "Top Spline", "trail", "#44aaff", "separate", 5)

wxBase = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wyBase = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wzBase = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
spdBase = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minS = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 1.0)
maxS = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
lenFac = input(0.1, "Length Factor Per Knot", 0.01, 1.0, 0.01)
highThr = input(30.0, "High Wind Threshold", 10.0, 80.0, 1.0)
lowThr = input(5.0, "Low Wind Threshold", 0.0, 20.0, 0.5)
shiftDeg = input(15.0, "Direction Shift Deg", 5.0, 45.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

wob = sin(bar_index / 12.0)
wob2 = cos(bar_index / 15.0)
drift = (close - close[1]) * 0.05
wvx = wxBase + 0.3 * wob + drift
wvy = wyBase + 0.3 * wob2 + drift * 0.5
wvz = wzBase + 0.2 * wob * wob2
spd = spdBase + 3.0 * wob + drift * 2.0

mag = sqrt(wvx * wvx + wvy * wvy + wvz * wvz)
magSafe = mag + 0.000000001
xRaw = wvx / magSafe
yRaw = wvy / magSafe
zRaw = wvz / magSafe
isZero = mag < 0.000001
xN = isZero ? 1.0 : xRaw
yN = isZero ? 0.0 : yRaw
zN = isZero ? 0.0 : zRaw

yaw = atan2(yN, xN) * 57.29578
horiz = sqrt(xN * xN + yN * yN + 0.000000000001)
pitch = atan2(zN, horiz) * 57.29578
roll = 0.0

span = maxS - minS + 0.000000001
rawT = (spd - minS) / span
lowClip = max(rawT, 0.0)
gradT = min(lowClip, 1.0)
tail = baseTail + spd * lenFac
gradR = gradT
gradG = 0.5 * gradT
gradB = 1.0 - gradT
gradSum = gradR + gradG + gradB
arrowColor = gradT > 0.66 ? "#ff8800" : gradT > 0.33 ? "#cc44cc" : "#2266ff"

yawPrev = yaw[1]
pitchPrev = pitch[1]
yawChg = abs(yaw - yawPrev)
pitchChg = abs(pitch - pitchPrev)
buySig = crossover(spd, highThr)
sellSig = crossunder(spd, lowThr)
shiftSig = yawChg > shiftDeg or pitchChg > shiftDeg

tipBar = bar_index + xN * tail * 2.0
tipPrice = close + zN * tail * (close * 0.002 + 1.0) + yN * tail * (close * 0.001)
arrow.new(bar_index, close, tipBar, tipPrice, arrowColor, 2, "solid", "none", "windArrow")

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "High Wind", "triangleup", "#ff8800")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "High Wind", "coneup", "#ff8800", markerSize, 0, "separate", pitch, yaw, roll)
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Low Wind", "triangledown", "#2266ff")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Low Wind", "conedown", "#2266ff", markerSize, 1, "separate", pitch, yaw, roll)
}
if shiftSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ffcc00", markerSize, 2, "separate", pitch, yaw, roll)
}

plot(spd, "Wind Speed kn", "#ff8800", 2, "separate")
plot(tail, "Tail Length", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(spd, "Wind Speed 3D", "ribbon", "#ff8800", "separate")
plot3d(tail, "Tail Length 3D", "line3d", "#2266ff", "separate", 1)

critThresh = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 50, 300, 1)
spinFactor = input(1.0, "Base Spin Factor", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
maxRings = input(5, "Max Rings", 1, 5, 1)
expandRate = input(2.0, "Ring Expansion Rate", 0.5, 10.0, 0.5)
flowMult = input(1.0, "Flow Multiplier", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
flow_psi = close * flowMult
spin_velocity = flow_psi * spinFactor * 0.1
overpressure_state = flow_psi > critThresh
var rotAngle = 0.0
var lockBars = 0.0
var lockedDisc = 0.0
if overpressure_state {
    lockBars := lockBars[1] + 1
    lockedDisc := rotAngle[1]
    rotAngle := rotAngle[1]
} else {
    lockBars := 0
    rotAngle := rotAngle[1] + spin_velocity
    if rotAngle >= 360 {
        rotAngle := rotAngle - 360
    }
    lockedDisc := rotAngle
}
ringOffset = 12 + close * 0.01
ringCount = maxRings
ring_radius1 = critThresh * flowMult + lockBars * expandRate + ringOffset * 1
ring_radius2 = critThresh * flowMult + lockBars * expandRate + ringOffset * 2 + ringCount
discVal = flow_psi + lockedDisc * 0.15
engageSig = overpressure_state and not overpressure_state[1]
clearSig = not overpressure_state and overpressure_state[1]
if engageSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if engageSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Valve Lock", "cube", "#ff4477", 1.2 * markerSize, 1, "separate", 0, lockedDisc, 0)
}
if engageSig {
    label3d(bar_index, flow_psi + 20, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 2, 3, "separate")
}
if clearSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Pressure Clear", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
plot(flow_psi, "Flow PSI", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(spin_velocity, "Spin Velocity", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(lockedDisc + flow_psi * 0.05, "Disc Angle", "#88ddff", 1, "separate")
hline(critThresh, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(discVal, "Valve Disc", "torus", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(ring_radius1, "Shock Ring 1", "trail", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)
plot3d(ring_radius2, "Shock Ring 2", "trail", "#ff8844", "separate", 2)
